Poland arrests Russian national over alleged plot to kill American in Warsaw

Poland has arrested a Russian national accused of plotting to assassinate an American citizen in Warsaw. Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk stated that the suspect was allegedly recruited by Russia's secret services. The plot was reportedly orchestrated by Moscow. The arrest was made in Warsaw.
